title: Jellyfish wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Jellyfish bell (body) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#FF6BAA'/>
  <!-- Bell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='38' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#FF9BC6'/>
  <!-- Bell bottom edge -->
  <path d='M22 48 Q30 58 38 50 Q46 60 54 50 Q62 60 70 50 Q76 56 78 48' fill='#E84A8A' stroke='#FF9BC6' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Tentacles -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q26 62 30 72 Q34 82 28 90' fill='none' stroke='#FF6BAA' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 54 Q36 66 42 76 Q46 84 40 92' fill='none' stroke='#FF9BC6' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 55 Q50 68 54 78 Q56 86 50 94' fill='none' stroke='#FF6BAA' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 54 Q64 66 58 76 Q54 84 60 92' fill='none' stroke='#FF9BC6' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 52 Q74 62 70 72 Q66 82 72 90' fill='none' stroke='#FF6BAA' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Party hat cone -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,38 62,38' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Hat stripe -->
  <polygon points='44,22 56,22 58,28 42,28' fill='#7B2FF2'/>
  <polygon points='41,31 59,31 60,36 40,36' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <!-- Hat pompom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='5' fill='#7B2FF2'/>
  <!-- Hat highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,10 43,34 47,34' fill='#FFE98A' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='43' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='43' rx='4.5' ry='5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='2.3' fill='#3D1A5B'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='2.3' fill='#3D1A5B'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='41.5' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41.5' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='49' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF4D6D' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='49' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF4D6D' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M45 51 Q50 55 55 51' fill='none' stroke='#3D1A5B' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
